page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock of 2.5 GHz. Configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, the system incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. It delivers 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512 (f and vnni variants), AES-NI, and BMI2. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage for operating system and data volumes, and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark measurements position the ecs.g6.2xlarge predominantly in the middle tier of general compute instances. Multi-core performance is consistent across evaluations, recording 4481.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 8191.37 in PassMark CPU tests. Memory subsystems show solid throughput, delivering 389.72 GB/sec in cached small-block reads, 48.91 GB/sec in uncached 256 MB reads, and a PassMark memory score of 2256.21. In-memory operations are robust, demonstrated by Redis achieving 6.4 million SET operations per second and PassMark database operations scoring 2777.42. Conversely, single-threaded throughput represents a performance bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core (1310.19), single-threaded gzip compression (22.53 GB/sec), and bzip3 decompression falling into the lower quartile.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the instance offers a predictable, dedicated hardware allocation that balances compute cores with sufficient working memory. The absence of integrated NVMe or SSD storage and the 2 Gbps network limit mean high-throughput sequential data streaming and heavy local I/O tasks face latency and bandwidth caps. The ecs.g6.2xlarge is well tailored for enterprise application servers, mid-sized relational and in-memory databases, software build pipelines, and containerized backend microservices that do not demand extreme single-core performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores via Intel Xeon 8269CY at 2.5 GHz) and 32.0 GB of RAM. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture and AVX-512 extensions, it maintains a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio. The instance includes no bundled local storage and operates with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks reflect balanced mid-range multi-core output, indicated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 4481.0, a PassMark CPU score of 8191.37, and Redis throughput reaching 6.4 million SET operations per second. Tradeoffs include lower single-core execution speeds and modest compression performance. The configuration is suitable for standard enterprise application hosting, software build runners, caching systems, and relational databases relying on attached cloud storage.
